parameters.content:
## DryRun debrief
When a rehearsal ends (POST /webhook/dryrun/debrief, docs/CONTRACT.md): counts the time, pace and filler words on each slide, has the model judge the pitch against the plan and the panel (marks on the transcript, scores with evidence, who would back it, a talk track per slide, the drill and weak spots), saves it to the DryRun sessions table step by step, emails the report and marks the meeting practised. The next /prep for the meeting reads it. GET /webhook/dryrun/session reads one session.
